n07d557d508.headline: The head of agricultural farmers announces fertilizer crisis will be resolved within days
n07d557d508.summary: Fertilizer prices in Egypt have risen sharply, with urea reaching about 7,000 Egyptian pounds per ton, impacting farmers.
n07d557d508.why: Fertilizer cost increases affect agricultural production costs and food supply chains, influencing inflation and rural economies.

n941b2b154d.headline: No Matter How Much Money the Government Injects, SMEs Will Not Increase Production or Hire Staff, Expert Says
n941b2b154d.summary: PwC partner Claudia Coppola stated that tax pressure, the dollar, and post-pandemic uncertainty are hindering SME growth plans despite government funding.
n941b2b154d.why: SMEs are critical for economic growth and employment; obstacles to their expansion affect broader economic recovery.
